verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no first-party observability or tracing UI that records every LLM call and tool invocation of an agent run. Hooks are callbacks a developer could use to build their own tracing, which makes them a building block rather than the capability. The hosting page's one-word mention of 'observability' does not describe any trace UI.

support.subject: As a developer, I can trace every LLM call and tool invocation of an agent run in an observability UI

citations.quote: Hooks are callback functions that run your code in response to agent events, like a tool being called, a session starting, or execution stopping.
